templates.name: Supabase
templates.description: Open-source Firebase alternative with PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime, Storage, and Edge Functions
templates.longDescription:
Supabase is a complete open-source Firebase alternative. It provides:

- **PostgreSQL Database** with automatic API generation
- **Authentication** with email, social, and magic link login
- **Realtime** subscriptions to database changes
- **Storage** for files with automatic image transformation
- **Edge Functions** for server-side TypeScript functions
- **Studio** dashboard for managing your data

This deployment includes all 9 Supabase services orchestrated via Docker Compose, ready for production use.

envVars.label: PostgreSQL Password
envVars.description: Master password for the Supabase database

envVars.label: JWT Secret
envVars.description: Secret used to sign JWT tokens (min 32 chars)

envVars.label: Anonymous API Key
envVars.description: Public anonymous key for client-side requests

envVars.label: Service Role Key
envVars.description: Service role key with full database access (keep secret!)

envVars.label: Secret Key Base
envVars.description: Base secret for Realtime service

envVars.label: Studio Username
envVars.description: Username for accessing the Supabase Studio dashboard

envVars.label: Studio Password
envVars.description: Password for accessing the Supabase Studio dashboard

templates.name: Appwrite
templates.description: Open-source backend-as-a-service — Auth, Database, Storage, Functions
templates.longDescription:
Appwrite is an open-source backend platform for building Web, Mobile, and Flutter apps.

- **Authentication** — Email/password, OAuth2, magic URLs, phone, anonymous
- **Database** — Document-based with SQL-like queries
- **Storage** — File storage with image processing
- **Functions** — Serverless cloud functions in 15+ languages
- **Realtime** — WebSocket subscriptions to any resource
- **Messaging** — Push notifications, SMS, email
- **GEO & Localization** — Built-in i18n support

Used by **30,000+** developers worldwide.

envVars.label: Admin Email
envVars.description: Email for the Appwrite Console root user

templates.name: PocketBase
templates.description: Open-source backend in a single file — Realtime, Auth, File Storage, REST API
templates.longDescription:
PocketBase is an open source backend consisting of:

- Embedded **SQLite** database with realtime subscriptions
- Built-in **Auth** management with multiple providers
- Convenient **Admin Dashboard** UI
- Simple **REST-ish API** for managing your data
- **File storage** with image transformations

Ships as a single executable file — no external dependencies. Perfect for SaaS,
mobile apps, and rapid prototyping.

**After deploy:** Visit `/_/` (e.g. http://your-host:port/_/) to create your
first superuser via the setup wizard. The env vars are stored for reference
but the first admin must be created through the web UI.

envVars.label: Admin Email
envVars.description: Email for the initial superuser account

envVars.label: Admin Password
envVars.description: Password for the initial superuser (must be at least 10 characters)

templates.name: Hasura
templates.description: Instant realtime GraphQL APIs on your data, with built-in authorization
templates.longDescription:
Hasura is an open-source engine that gives you instant GraphQL & REST APIs
with authorization & event triggers — over Postgres, MS SQL Server, BigQuery, MySQL, and more.

- **Instant GraphQL & REST APIs** on your database
- **Granular authorization** with role-based access
- **Real-time subscriptions** out of the box
- **Event triggers** for serverless workflows
- **Schema stitching** & remote schemas
- **Caching** for high-performance APIs
- **Console UI** for managing schema, permissions, and metadata

envVars.label: Admin Secret
envVars.description: Secret for accessing the Hasura console and admin APIs

envVars.label: Enable Console
envVars.description: Enable the web console at /console

envVars.label: Dev Mode
envVars.description: Show detailed error messages (set false for production)

templates.name: Directus
templates.description: Open-source headless CMS and instant REST + GraphQL API for any SQL database
templates.longDescription:
Directus is an Open Data Platform built to democratize the database. It provides
everyone on your team, regardless of technical skill, equal access to data and digital file
asset management.

- **Headless CMS** with a beautiful no-code admin app
- **Instant REST + GraphQL API** for any SQL database
- **File library** with image transformations
- **Roles & permissions** with granular access control
- **Webhooks & flows** for automation
- **Real-time updates** via subscriptions
- **Multi-language** content management

envVars.label: Admin Email
envVars.description: Email for the initial admin user

envVars.label: Admin Password
envVars.description: Password for the initial admin user

templates.name: NocoDB
templates.description: Open-source Airtable alternative — turn any database into a smart spreadsheet
templates.longDescription:
NocoDB is an open-source Airtable alternative. It works on top of any
relational database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, MariaDB) and provides a
spreadsheet-like UI to manage data.

- **Spreadsheet UI** for any SQL database
- **REST + GraphQL APIs** auto-generated
- **Roles & permissions** with granular access
- **Form, Gallery, Kanban, Grid** views
- **Webhooks & Zapier** integrations
- **Collaborative** real-time editing
- 50K+ stars on GitHub

templates.name: Meilisearch
templates.description: Lightning-fast, open-source search engine — Algolia alternative
templates.longDescription:
Meilisearch is a powerful, fast, open-source, easy to use, and deploy search engine.
Both searching and indexing are highly customizable. Features such as typo tolerance, filters,
and synonyms are provided out-of-the-box.

- **Sub-50ms response times** for most queries
- **Typo-tolerant** search with smart corrections
- **Faceted search** and filtering
- **Geo-search** support
- **Multi-tenant** with API key management
- Used in production by **Louis Vuitton, OpenAI, Lacoste**

envVars.label: Master Key
envVars.description: Master API key for protected access (min 16 chars)

envVars.label: Environment
envVars.description: Set to "production" for prod, "development" for dev (enables web UI)

envVars.label: Disable Analytics
envVars.description: Disable telemetry sent to Meilisearch

templates.name: Typesense
templates.description: Open-source, typo-tolerant search engine optimized for instant search
templates.longDescription:
Typesense is an open-source, typo-tolerant search engine optimized for
instant (typically sub-50ms) search-as-you-type experiences and developer productivity.

- **Typo-tolerant** search with built-in fuzzy matching
- **Faceted search** and dynamic filtering
- **Geo-search** with radius queries
- **Synonyms** and curated results
- **Vector search** for semantic search
- **Multi-tenancy** with scoped API keys
- Easy to use **REST API**

envVars.label: API Key
envVars.description: Master API key for accessing Typesense

templates.name: WordPress
templates.description: The most popular open-source CMS powering 40% of the web.
templates.longDescription: WordPress is a free and open-source content management system. It is the most popular website builder, powering over 40% of all websites on the internet. Features include themes, plugins, a visual editor, and a robust REST API.

templates.name: Ghost
templates.description: Professional publishing platform for blogs, newsletters, and paid subscriptions.
templates.longDescription: Ghost is a powerful open-source publishing platform for professional bloggers and publishers. Built on Node.js, it features a modern editor, built-in SEO, native newsletters, memberships, and paid subscriptions out of the box.

templates.name: Strapi
templates.description: Open-source headless CMS with customizable API and admin panel.
templates.longDescription: Strapi is the leading open-source headless CMS. It enables developers to build, deploy, and manage content APIs quickly. Features include a customizable admin panel, role-based access, REST & GraphQL APIs, and plugin system.

templates.name: NextCloud
templates.description: Self-hosted productivity platform — files, calendar, contacts, and more
templates.longDescription:
Nextcloud is a content collaboration platform that enables you to access, share,
and collaborate across your devices.

- **File sync & share** — Google Drive / Dropbox alternative
- **Calendar & Contacts** — replace Google Calendar/Contacts
- **Photos** — automatic uploads from mobile
- **Office suite** — collaborative editing (Collabora/OnlyOffice)
- **Talk** — video calls and chat
- **End-to-end encryption** support
- **400+ apps** in the marketplace
- Used by **Deutsche Bahn, EU Commission, ownCloud**

envVars.description: Username for the initial admin account

envVars.description: Password for the initial admin account (min 10 characters recommended)

envVars.description: Space-separated list of domains allowed to access Nextcloud (use * for any)

templates.name: Cal.com
templates.description: Open-source Calendly alternative — schedule meetings without back-and-forth emails
templates.longDescription:
Cal.com is the open-source alternative to Calendly. Self-host a beautiful
scheduling tool that connects to all your calendars and integrates with the apps you love.

- **Beautiful booking pages** — public scheduling links
- **Calendar integrations** — Google, Outlook, iCloud, Office 365
- **Video conferencing** — Zoom, Google Meet, Daily.co built-in
- **Custom forms** — collect info during booking
- **Team scheduling** — round-robin, collective, managed events
- **Workflows** — automated reminders, follow-ups
- **Embed everywhere** — inline, popup, or redirect
- 30K+ stars on GitHub

templates.name: code-server
templates.description: VS Code in your browser — full IDE accessible from anywhere
templates.longDescription:
code-server is VS Code running on a remote server, accessible through the browser.

- **Full VS Code** experience — extensions, themes, settings sync
- **Code from anywhere** — iPad, Chromebook, low-power devices
- **Consistent dev environment** across machines
- **Long-running tasks** keep running when you close the browser
- **Test your apps** in the same network as your servers
- 70K+ stars on GitHub
- Made by **Coder** (the people behind VS Code's remote extension protocol)

envVars.label: Login Password
envVars.description: Password for accessing your code-server instance

templates.name: Vaultwarden
templates.description: Self-hosted Bitwarden — secure password manager for individuals and teams
templates.longDescription:
Vaultwarden is an unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust,
formerly known as bitwarden_rs. Lighter than the official server and works with all
official Bitwarden clients (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions).

- **End-to-end encrypted** password vault
- **All Bitwarden clients** work out of the box
- **2FA / TOTP** built-in authenticator
- **Organizations** for team password sharing
- **Send** secure file/text sharing
- **Lightweight** — runs on as little as 64MB RAM

templates.name: Uptime Kuma
templates.description: Self-hosted monitoring tool like Uptime Robot. Beautiful status pages included.
templates.longDescription: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool. Monitor HTTP, TCP, DNS, and more with a beautiful UI. Features include status pages, notifications via 90+ services (Telegram, Discord, Slack, Email), and multi-language support.

templates.name: Gitea
templates.description: Lightweight self-hosted Git service. GitHub/GitLab alternative.
templates.longDescription: Gitea is a painless self-hosted Git service. It is lightweight, easy to install, and runs great on minimal hardware. Features include repositories, issues, pull requests, CI/CD (Gitea Actions), packages, and wikis.

templates.name: Portainer
templates.description: Container management UI for Docker. Visualize and manage your containers.
templates.longDescription: Portainer is a lightweight management UI that allows you to easily manage Docker environments. It provides a web-based interface for managing containers, images, volumes, and networks without needing to use the CLI.

templates.name: MinIO
templates.description: High-performance S3-compatible object storage. Self-hosted AWS S3 alternative.
templates.longDescription: MinIO is a high-performance, S3-compatible object storage system. It is designed for large-scale AI/ML, data lake, and backup workloads. MinIO is software-defined and runs on any cloud or on-premises infrastructure.

templates.name: Umami
templates.description: Privacy-friendly, open-source Google Analytics alternative
templates.longDescription:
Umami is a simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.

- **No cookies** — no GDPR / cookie banner needed
- **Privacy-first** — anonymized data, no personal info
- **Lightweight tracker** (~2KB script)
- **Beautiful dashboards** with realtime data
- **Multi-site** support from a single instance
- **Custom events** and goals tracking
- **Open source** with 22K+ stars

templates.name: Plausible Analytics
templates.description: Privacy-friendly web analytics. Simple, lightweight Google Analytics alternative.
templates.longDescription: Plausible Analytics is a lightweight and open-source web analytics tool. It does not use cookies, is fully compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and PECR, and the script is less than 1KB. A privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics.
